title: Extract EngramSessionState and its Default from engram_host_adapter.rs
outcome: From tm-winf round-10 review (Claude, Note). engram_host_adapter.rs is ~6,700 lines, more than twice the ~3,000-line Rust threshold; tm-winf added session-state fields (running_command_keys, withheld_command_keys, next_turn_check_sequence, shell_directory, active_turn_checks) and checkpoint plumbing there. Extracting EngramSessionState with its Default into its own fragment (header comment per CLAUDE.md split rules, pure code move) is a low-risk step. Related: tm-ydbw, tm-4soy.
